body:
Fix applied. All Framer Motion `initial={{ opacity: 0 }}` patterns converted to transform-only inits so content is visible by default even if JS fails to hydrate.

**Files changed:**
- `src/components/About/AboutCard.tsx` — 6 occurrences: section header `y:30`, card `y:50`, 3 stat rows `x:-20`, bio `` (empty), border glow left as-is (hover `animate`, not entrance)
- `src/components/Projects/ProjectGrid.tsx` — 3 occurrences: header `y:30`, FREE banner `y:20`, GitHub links `y:20`, project cards `scale:0.9`
- `src/components/Projects/ProjectCard.tsx` — 1 occurrence: `y:50`
- `src/components/Blog/BlogList.tsx` — 2 occurrences: header `y:30`, "View All" `` (empty)
- `src/components/Blog/BlogCard.tsx` — 1 occurrence: `y:30`
- `src/components/Blog/RelatedPosts.tsx` — 1 occurrence: `y:20`
- `src/components/Blog/NewsletterEmbed.tsx` — 1 occurrence: `y:20`
- `src/components/UI/Footer.tsx` — 3 occurrences: all `` (empty)
- `src/components/Hero/ScrollIndicator.tsx` — 1 occurrence: `y:-20`

**Verification:**
- `npx tsc --noEmit` — passes (no output)
- `npx astro build` — 40 pages, 6.19s, complete
- `dist/index.html` grep `opacity:0` — 3 hits, all CSS keyframe animations (`.letter`, `.subtitle`, `astroFadeOut`) and one decorative hover border glow. Zero Framer Motion `initial={{ opacity: 0 }}` inline styles remain.

**Result:** Content now renders visible immediately on SSR. Framer Motion `whileInView` still animates the slide-up/scale entrance as an enhancement when JS hydrates successfully. If JS fails, content is visible (possibly slightly offset by the transform value). Navigation mobile menu `initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}` left untouched — that's a click-triggered drawer, not an entrance animation.
